docs.Instance: Instance is the base class for all classes in the Roblox class hierarchy which can be part of the DataModel tree.
docs.Instance.Parent: Determines the hierarchical parent of the Instance.
docs.Instance.ClassName: A read-only string representing the class this Object belongs to.
docs.Instance.Name: A non-unique identifier of the Instance.
docs.Instance.Archivable: Determines if an Instance and its descendants can be cloned using Instance:Clone(), and can be saved/published.
docs.Instance:GetChildren: Returns an array containing all of the instance's children.
docs.Instance:GetDescendants: Returns an array containing all of the descendants of the instance.
docs.Instance:FindFirstChild: Returns the first child of the Instance found with the given name.
docs.Instance:FindFirstChildOfClass: Returns the first child of the Instance whose ClassName is equal to the given class name.
docs.Instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA: Returns the first child of the Instance for whom Object:IsA() returns true for the given className.
docs.Instance:FindFirstAncestor: Returns the first ancestor of the Instance whose Instance.Name is equal to the given name.
docs.Instance:IsA: Returns true if an object's class matches or inherits from a given class.
docs.Instance:IsDescendantOf: Returns true if an Instance is a descendant of the given ancestor.
docs.Instance:GetPropertyChangedSignal: Get an event that fires when a given property of the object changes.
docs.Instance:Destroy: Sets the Instance.Parent property to nil, locks the Instance.Parent property, disconnects all connections, and calls Destroy() on all children.
docs.Instance:Clone: Create a copy of an instance and all its descendants, ignoring instances that are not Archivable.
docs.Instance:ClearAllChildren: This method destroys all of an instance's children.
docs.Instance:GetFullName: Returns a string describing the instance's ancestry.
docs.Instance:WaitForChild: Returns the child of the Instance with the given name. If the child does not exist, it will yield the current thread until it does.
docs.Instance.ChildAdded: Fires after an object is parented to this Instance.
docs.Instance.ChildRemoved: Fires after a child is removed from this Instance.
docs.Instance.Changed: Fires immediately after a property of the object changes, with some limitations.
docs.Instance.Destroying: Fires immediately before (or is deferred until after) the instance is destroyed via Instance:Destroy().
docs.DataModel: The root of Roblox's parent-child hierarchy. Its direct children are services, such as Workspace and Lighting, that act as the fundamental components of a Roblox game.
docs.DataModel:GetService: Returns the service with the requested class name, creating it if it does not exist.
docs.Workspace: Workspace houses 3D objects which are rendered to the 3D world. Objects not descending from it will not be rendered or physically interact with the world.
docs.Workspace.Gravity: Determines the acceleration due to gravity applied to falling BaseParts.
docs.Workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight: Determines the height at which falling BaseParts and their ancestor Models are removed from Workspace.
docs.Workspace.CurrentCamera: The Camera object being used by the local player.
docs.Workspace.GlobalWind: Specifies the global wind vector for animated terrain grass, dynamic clouds, and particles.
docs.Folder: A simple container used to hold and organize Roblox instances.
docs.RunService: Service responsible for all runtime activity and progression of time.
docs.RunService:IsClient: Returns whether the current environment is running on the client.
docs.RunService:IsServer: Returns whether the current environment is running on the server.
docs.RunService:IsStudio: Returns whether the current environment is running in Studio.
docs.RunService:IsRunning: Returns whether the experience is currently running.
docs.RunService:IsEdit: Returns whether the current environment is in Edit mode.
docs.RunService.PreAnimation: Fires every frame, prior to the physics simulation but after rendering.
docs.RunService.PreSimulation: Fires every frame, prior to the physics simulation.
docs.RunService.Stepped: Fires every frame, prior to the physics simulation.
docs.RunService.PostSimulation: Fires every frame, after the physics simulation has completed.
docs.RunService.Heartbeat: Fires every frame, after the physics simulation has completed.
docs.RunService.PreRender: Fires every frame, prior to the frame being rendered.
docs.RunService.RenderStepped: Fires every frame, prior to the frame being rendered.
docs.TweenBase: Abstract base class for in-between interpolation handlers. Tween inherits from TweenBase.
docs.TweenBase.PlaybackState: Read-only property that shows the current state for the Tween animation.
docs.TweenBase:Play: Starts playback of a tween. Note that if playback has already started, calling Play() has no effect unless the tween has finished or is stopped (either by TweenBase:Cancel() or TweenBase:Pause()).
docs.TweenBase:Pause: Halts playback of the tween. Doesn't reset its progress variables, meaning that if you call TweenBase:Play(), the tween resumes playback from the moment it was paused.
docs.TweenBase:Cancel: Halts playback and resets the tween variables. If you then call TweenBase:Play(), the properties of the tween resume interpolating towards their destination, but take the full length of the animation to do so.
docs.TweenBase.Completed: Fires when the tween finishes playing or when stopped with TweenBase:Cancel().
docs.Tween: The Tween object controls the playback of an interpolation.
docs.Tween.Instance: Read-only property that points to the Instance whose properties are being interpolated by the tween.
docs.Tween.TweenInfo: Read-only property that includes information on how the interpolation of the Tween is to be carried out.
docs.TweenService: Used to create Tweens which interpolate, or tween, the properties of instances.
docs.TweenService:Create: Creates a new Tween given the object whose properties are to be tweened, a TweenInfo, and a dictionary of goal property values.
docs.TweenService:GetValue: Calculates a new alpha given an Enum.EasingStyle and Enum.EasingDirection.
docs.ReplicatedStorage: A container service for objects that are replicated to all clients.
docs.ReplicatedFirst: A container whose contents are replicated to all clients (but not back to the server) first before anything else.
docs.ServerStorage: A container whose contents are only accessible on the server. Objects descending from ServerStorage will not replicate to the client and will not be accessible from LocalScripts.
docs.ServerScriptService: A container service for server-only Script objects.
docs.StarterPack: A container whose contents are copied into each player's Backpack when their player character spawns. It is generally used to hold Tools.
docs.StarterPlayer: A service which allows the defaults of properties in the Player object to be set.
docs.StarterGui: A container for LayerCollector objects to be copied into the PlayerGui of Players. Also provides a range of functions for interacting with the CoreGui.
docs.StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled: Sets whether the CoreGui element associated with the given Enum.CoreGuiType is enabled or disabled.
docs.StarterGui:GetCoreGuiEnabled: Returns whether the given Enum.CoreGuiTypeis enabled, or if it has been disabled using StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled().
docs.GuiBase2d: An abstract class inherited by 2D GuiObjects.
docs.GuiBase2d.AbsolutePosition: Describes the actual screen position of a GuiBase2d element, in pixels.
docs.GuiBase2d.AbsoluteSize: Describes the actual screen size of a GuiBase2d element, in pixels.
docs.GuiBase2d.AbsoluteRotation: Describes the actual screen rotation of a GuiBase2d element, in degrees.
docs.LayerCollector: The base class of 2D UI containers which render GuiObjects in layers.
docs.LayerCollector.Enabled: Toggles the visibility of this LayerCollector.
docs.LayerCollector.ResetOnSpawn: Determines if the LayerCollector resets (deletes itself and re-clones into the player's PlayerGui) every time the player's character respawns.
docs.LayerCollector.ZIndexBehavior: Controls how GuiObject.ZIndex behaves on all descendants of this LayerCollector.
docs.ScreenGui: Primary container of on-screen 2D user interface elements.
docs.ScreenGui.IgnoreGuiInset: Determines whether the ScreenGui overflows into the range of Roblox's core UI elements.
docs.ScreenGui.DisplayOrder: Controls the Z-index order in which multiple ScreenGui containers are drawn.
docs.GuiObject: An abstract class for all 2D user interface objects.
docs.GuiObject.Size: Determines the pixel and scalar size of the GuiObject.
docs.GuiObject.Position: Determines the pixel and scalar position of the GuiObject.
docs.GuiObject.AnchorPoint: Determines the origin point of a GuiObject, relative to its absolute size.
docs.GuiObject.BackgroundTransparency: Determines the transparency of the GuiObject background and border.
docs.GuiObject.BorderSizePixel: Determines the pixel width of the GuiObject border.
docs.GuiObject.BorderColor3: Determines the color of the GuiObject border.
docs.GuiObject.Visible: Determines whether the GuiObject and its descendants will be rendered.
docs.GuiObject.ZIndex: Determines the order in which a GuiObject renders relative to others.
docs.GuiObject.Rotation: Determines the number of degrees by which the GuiObject is rotated.
docs.GuiObject.LayoutOrder: Controls the sort order of the GuiObject when used with a UIGridStyleLayout.
docs.GuiObject.ClipsDescendants: Determines if descendant GuiObjects outside of the bounds of a parent GUI element should render.
docs.GuiObject.Active: Determines whether this UI element sinks input.
docs.GuiObject.MouseEnter: Fires when a user moves their mouse into a GUI element.
docs.GuiObject.MouseLeave: Fires when a user moves their mouse out of a GUI element.
docs.GuiObject.InputBegan: Fired when a user begins interacting via a Human-Computer Interface device (Mouse button down, touch begin, keyboard button down, etc).
docs.GuiObject.InputEnded: Fired when a user stops interacting via a Human-Computer Interface device (Mouse button down, touch begin, keyboard button down, etc).
docs.Frame: A GuiObject that renders as a plain rectangle, generally used as a container.
docs.ScrollingFrame: ScrollingFrame is a special Frame type with built-in scrolling interactivity and different ways to customize how the scrolling works.
docs.ScrollingFrame.AbsoluteCanvasSize: The size of the area that is scrollable, in offsets.
docs.ScrollingFrame.AbsoluteWindowSize: The size of the frame, in offsets, without the scroll bars.
docs.ScrollingFrame.AutomaticCanvasSize: Determines whether ScrollingFrame.CanvasSize is resized based on child content.
docs.ScrollingFrame.CanvasPosition: Reflects the current positional offset of the canvas within the frame, in pixels, and sets the position of scroll bars accordingly.
docs.ScrollingFrame.CanvasSize: Determines the size of the scrollable area.
docs.ScrollingFrame.ElasticBehavior: Determines if and when elastic scrolling is allowed on touch‑enabled devices.
docs.ScrollingFrame.HorizontalScrollBarInset: Indicates whether CanvasSize is inset by ScrollBarThickness on the horizontal axis.
docs.ScrollingFrame.VerticalScrollBarInset: Indicates whether CanvasSize is inset by ScrollBarThickness on the vertical axis.
docs.ScrollingFrame.VerticalScrollBarPosition: Indicates whether the vertical scroll bar is positioned to the left or right of the canvas.
docs.ScrollingFrame.ScrollBarImageColor3: Determines how the rendered scroll bar images are colorized.
docs.ScrollingFrame.ScrollBarImageTransparenc: Determines the opacity of the scroll bar images.
docs.ScrollingFrame.ScrollBarThickness: Thickness of the scroll bar in pixels; applies to both horizontal and vertical scroll bars.
docs.ScrollingFrame.ScrollingDirection: Determines the direction(s) in which scrolling is allowed.
docs.ScrollingFrame.ScrollingEnabled: Determines whether scrolling is allowed on the frame.
docs.ScrollingFrame.TopImage: Image which displays on the top of a vertical scroll bar, or the left of a horizontal scroll bar (rotated 90° counterclockwise for a horizontal scroll bar).
docs.ScrollingFrame.MidImage: Image which spans the area between TopImage and BottomImage (rotated 90° counterclockwise for a horizontal scroll bar).
docs.ScrollingFrame.BottomImage: Image that displays on the bottom of a vertical scroll bar, or the right of a horizontal scroll bar (rotated 90° counterclockwise for a horizontal scroll bar).
docs.TextLabel: A 2D user interface element that displays non-interactive text.
docs.TextLabel.Text: Determines the string rendered by the TextLabel.
docs.TextLabel.TextColor3: Determines the color of rendered text.
docs.TextLabel.TextSize: Determines the line height of text in offsets.
docs.TextLabel.Font: Determines the font used to render text.
docs.TextLabel.TextScaled: Changes whether text is resized to fit within the TextLabel.
docs.TextLabel.TextWrapped: Determines if text wraps to multiple lines within the TextLabel
docs.TextLabel.TextXAlignment: Determines the horizontal alignment of rendered text.
docs.TextLabel.TextYAlignment: Determines the vertical alignment of rendered text.
docs.TextLabel.TextTransparency: Determines the transparency of rendered text.
docs.TextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency: Determines the transparency of the text stroke (outline).
docs.TextLabel.TextStrokeColor3: Determines the color of the text stroke (outline).
docs.TextLabel.RichText: Determines whether the TextLabel renders its text using rich text formatting.
docs.TextLabel.LineHeight: Scales the spacing between lines of text in the TextLabel.
docs.TextLabel.TextTruncate: Controls the truncation of the text displayed in the TextLabel.
docs.TextLabel.FontFace: Determines the font used to render text.
docs.ImageLabel: A 2D user interface element that displays a single non-interactive image.
docs.ImageLabel.Image: The image content displayed by the UI element. Reads and writes to ImageContent.
docs.ImageLabel.ImageColor3: Determines how a rendered image will be colorized.
docs.ImageLabel.ImageTransparency: Determines the transparency of the rendered image.
docs.ImageLabel.ScaleType: Determines how an image will scale if displayed in a UI element whose size differs from the source image.
docs.GuiButton: An abstract class for interactive 2D user interface elements.
docs.GuiButton.AutoButtonColor: Determines whether the button automatically changes color when the mouse hovers over or clicks on it.
docs.GuiButton.Active: Determines whether this UI element sinks input.
docs.GuiButton.Activated: Fires when the button is activated.
docs.GuiButton.MouseButton1Click: Fires when the user's mouse fully left clicks the GuiButton.
docs.GuiButton.MouseButton1Down: Fires when the user presses their left mouse button down on the GuiButton.
docs.GuiButton.MouseButton1Up: Fires when the user releases their left mouse button off of the GuiButton.
docs.TextButton: A 2D user interface element that displays interactive text.
docs.TextButton.Text: Determines the string rendered by the TextButton.
docs.TextButton.TextColor3: Determines the color of rendered text.
docs.TextButton.TextSize: Determines the line height of text in offsets.
docs.TextButton.Font: Determines the font used to render text.
docs.TextButton.TextScaled: Changes whether text is resized to fit within the TextButton.
docs.TextButton.TextWrapped: Determines if text wraps to multiple lines within the TextButton element's space, truncating excess text.
docs.TextButton.TextXAlignment: Determines the horizontal alignment of rendered text.
docs.TextButton.TextYAlignment: Determines the vertical alignment of rendered text.
docs.TextButton.TextTransparency: Determines the transparency of rendered text.
docs.TextButton.TextStrokeTransparency: Determines the transparency of the text stroke (outline).
docs.TextButton.TextStrokeColor3: Determines the color of the text stroke (outline).
docs.TextButton.RichText: Determines whether the TextButton renders its text using rich text formatting.
docs.TextButton.LineHeight: Scales the spacing between lines of text in the TextButton.
docs.TextButton.TextTruncate: Controls the truncation of the text displayed in the TextButton.
docs.TextButton.FontFace: Determines the font used to render text.
docs.ImageButton: A 2D user interface element that displays an interactive image.
docs.ImageButton.Image: The image content displayed by the ImageButton element. Reads and writes to ImageContent.
docs.ImageButton.ImageColor3: Determines how a rendered image will be colorized.
docs.ImageButton.ImageTransparency: Determines the transparency of the rendered image.
docs.ImageButton.ScaleType: Determines how an image will scale if displayed in a UI element whose size differs from the source image.
docs.TextBox: A 2D user interface element that displays player-editable text.
docs.TextBox.Text: Determines the string rendered by the TextBox element.
docs.TextBox.TextColor3: Determines the color of non-placeholder rendered text.
docs.TextBox.TextSize: Determine the line height of text in offsets.
docs.TextBox.Font: Determines the font used to render text.
docs.TextBox.TextScaled: Changes whether text is resized to fit within the TextBox.
docs.TextBox.TextWrapped: Determines if text wraps to multiple lines within the TextBox element space, truncating excess text.
docs.TextBox.TextXAlignment: Determines the horizontal alignment of the rendered text.
docs.TextBox.TextYAlignment: Determines the vertical alignment of the rendered text.
docs.TextBox.TextTransparency: Determines the transparency of the rendered text.
docs.TextBox.TextStrokeTransparency: Determines the transparency of the text stroke (outline).
docs.TextBox.TextStrokeColor3: Determines the color of the text stroke (outline).
docs.TextBox.RichText: Determines whether the TextBox renders the Text string using rich text formatting.
docs.TextBox.LineHeight: Scales the spacing between lines of text in the TextBox.
docs.TextBox.TextTruncate: Controls the truncation of the text displayed in the TextBox.
docs.TextBox.FontFace: Determines the font face used to render text.
docs.TextBox.ClearTextOnFocus: Determines whether clicking on the TextBox will clear its TextBox.Text property.
docs.TextBox.MultiLine: When set to true, text inside a TextBox is able to move onto multiple lines.
docs.TextBox.TextEditable: Determines whether the player can change the Text.
docs.TextBox.PlaceholderText: Sets the text that gets displayed when no text has been entered into the TextBox.
docs.TextBox.PlaceholderColor3: Sets the text color that gets used when no text has been entered into the TextBox.
docs.TextBox.ShowNativeInput: If set to true, input native to the platform is used instead of Roblox's built-in keyboard.
docs.TextBox:CaptureFocus: Forces the client to focus on the TextBox.
docs.TextBox:ReleaseFocus: Forces the client to unfocus the TextBox.
docs.TextBox:IsFocused: Whether the TextBox currently has focus.
docs.TextBox.Focused: Fires when the TextBox gains focus.
docs.TextBox.FocusLost: Fires when the TextBox loses its focus.
docs.UIComponent: A base class for UI constraint and layout classes.
docs.UICorner: UI modifier which applies deformation to corners of its parent GuiObject.
docs.UICorner.CornerRadius: Sets all four corner radii at once and reads from TopLeftRadius.
docs.UIStroke: Applies an outline to text or a UI border.
docs.UIStroke.Transparency: Sets the stroke opacity independently of the parent object's BackgroundTransparency or TextTransparency.
docs.UIStroke.ApplyStrokeMode: Determines whether to apply the stroke to the object's border instead of the text itself.
docs.UIStroke.Enabled: Determines whether the stroke in visible.
docs.UIPadding: Applies padding to the borders of the parent GuiObject.
docs.UIPadding.PaddingTop: Padding to apply on the top side, relative to the parent's normal size.
docs.UIPadding.PaddingBottom: Padding to apply on the bottom side, relative to the parent's normal size.
docs.UIPadding.PaddingLeft: Padding to apply on the left side, relative to the parent's normal size.
docs.UIPadding.PaddingRight: Padding to apply on the right side, relative to the parent's normal size.
docs.UILayout: The base class for UI layout classes.
docs.UIGridStyleLayout: The base class for grid style UI layouts.
docs.UIGridStyleLayout.AbsoluteContentSize: The absolute size of space being taken up by the grid layout.
docs.UIListLayout: Positions sibling UI elements in rows or columns within the parent UI container.
docs.UIListLayout.FillDirection: Determines the axis in which UI objects are laid out.
docs.UIListLayout.HorizontalAlignment: Determines the horizontal alignment of UI elements within the parent element.
docs.UIListLayout.VerticalAlignment: Determines the vertical alignment of UI elements within the parent element.
docs.UIListLayout.SortOrder: Determines the order in which child UI objects are placed in a layout.
docs.UIListLayout.Padding: Amount of free space between each element.
docs.UIGridLayout: Positions sibling UI elements by filling rows using the space of the parent UI element.
docs.UIGridLayout.CellPadding: Determines how much space there is between elements in the grid.
docs.UIGridLayout.CellSize: Determines the size of each element in the grid.
docs.UIGridLayout.FillDirection: Determines the axis in which UI objects are laid out.
docs.UIGridLayout.FillDirectionMaxCells: Determines the maximum number of cells that may be used in a row or column before the next one is started.
docs.UIGridLayout.HorizontalAlignment: Determines the horizontal alignment of UI elements within the parent element.
docs.UIGridLayout.VerticalAlignment: Determines the vertical alignment of UI elements within the parent element.
docs.UIGridLayout.SortOrder: Determines the order in which child UI objects are placed in a layout.
docs.UIGridLayout.StartCorner: Determines from which corner the grid starts laying out UI elements.
docs.UIGridLayout.AbsoluteCellCount: The number of elements in the grid.
docs.UIGridLayout.AbsoluteCellSize: The absolute size of each element in the grid.
docs.UIGradient: Applies a color and transparency gradient to the parent GuiObject.
docs.UIGradient.Color: Determines the color blended with the parent GuiObject along the length of the gradient.
docs.UIGradient.Transparency: Determines how much the parent GuiObject can be seen through along the length of the gradient.
docs.UIGradient.Offset: Determines the scalar translation of the gradient from the center of the parent GuiObject.
docs.UIGradient.Rotation: Determines the clockwise rotation in degrees of the gradient starting from left to right.
docs.UIGradient.Enabled: Whether the gradient is enabled or not.
docs.UIAspectRatioConstraint: Ensures the parent UI element maintains a particular aspect ratio.
docs.UIAspectRatioConstraint.AspectRatio: Determines the width-to-height ratio to maintain.
docs.UIAspectRatioConstraint.AspectType: Determines how the maximum size of the object is limited.
docs.UIAspectRatioConstraint.DominantAxis: Determines the axis to use when setting the new size of the object.
docs.UIScale: An object that acts as a multiplier for the size of the parent UI element's scale.
docs.UIScale.Scale: Determines the multiplier to apply to the parent UI element's size.
docs.UISizeConstraint: Ensures a GuiObject does not become larger or smaller than the constraint's maximum size or minimum size.
docs.UISizeConstraint.MinSize: The smallest size, in pixels, the object is allowed to be.
docs.UISizeConstraint.MaxSize: The largest size, in pixels, the parent object is allowed to be.
docs.UITextSizeConstraint: Ensures that the size of text rendered by certain GuiObject classes lies within the range described by MaxTextSize and MinTextSize.
docs.UITextSizeConstraint.MinTextSize: The smallest size in pixels the font is allowed to be.
docs.UITextSizeConstraint.MaxTextSize: The largest size in pixels the font is allowed to be.
docs.PlayerGui: A container that holds a player's UI.
docs.Backpack: A container object that holds a player's inventory. Any Tool in a player's Backpack will be displayed in their inventory at the bottom of the screen.
docs.PlayerScripts: A container for client-side scripts to be run inside Player objects within the Players service.
docs.StarterPlayerScripts: A container for objects to be copied to a Player's PlayerScripts when they join a game.
docs.StarterCharacterScripts: Stores instances to be parented to a player's character when it spawns.
docs.Model: Models are container objects, meaning they group objects together. They are best used to hold collections of BaseParts and have a number of functions that extend their functionality.
docs.Model.PrimaryPart: The primary part of the Model, or nil if not explicitly set.
docs.Model:GetPivot: Gets the pivot of a PVInstance.
docs.Model:PivotTo: Transforms the PVInstance along with all of its descendant PVInstances such that the pivot is now located at the specified CFrame.
docs.BasePart: The abstract base class for in-world objects that physically interact.
docs.BasePart.CFrame: Determines the position and orientation of the BasePart in the world.
docs.BasePart.Position: Describes the position of the part in the world.
docs.BasePart.Orientation: Describes the rotation of the part in the world.
docs.BasePart.Size: Determines the dimensions of a part (length, height, width).
docs.BasePart.Anchored: Determines whether a part is immovable by physics.
docs.BasePart.CanCollide: Determines whether a part may collide with other parts.
docs.BasePart.CanTouch: Determines if Touched and TouchEnded events fire on the part.
docs.BasePart.CanQuery: Determines whether the part is considered during spatial query operations.
docs.BasePart.Transparency: Determines how much a part can be seen through (the inverse of part opacity).
docs.BasePart.BrickColor: Determines the color of a part.
docs.BasePart.Color: Determines the color of a part.
docs.BasePart.Material: Determines the texture and default physical properties of a part.
docs.BasePart.Reflectance: Determines how much a part reflects the skybox.
docs.BasePart.Locked: Determines whether a part is selectable in Studio.
docs.BasePart.AssemblyLinearVelocity: The linear velocity of the part's assembly.
docs.BasePart.AssemblyAngularVelocity: The angular velocity of the part's assembly.
docs.BasePart.Massless: Determines whether the part contributes to the total mass or inertia of its rigid body.
docs.BasePart.RootPriority: The main rule in determining the root part of an assembly.
docs.BasePart.AssemblyRootPart: A reference to the root part of the assembly.
docs.BasePart:GetPivot: Gets the pivot of a PVInstance.
docs.BasePart:GetRootPart: Returns the base part of an assembly of parts.
docs.BasePart:GetConnectedParts: Returns a table of parts connected to the object by any kind of rigid joint.
docs.BasePart:GetJoints: Returns all Joints or Constraints connected to this part that are active in the simulation.
docs.BasePart:PivotTo: Transforms the PVInstance along with all of its descendant PVInstances such that the pivot is now located at the specified CFrame.
docs.BasePart:UnionAsync: Creates a new UnionOperation from the part, plus the geometry occupied by the parts in the given array.
docs.BasePart:SubtractAsync: Creates a new UnionOperation from the part, minus the geometry occupied by the parts in the given array.
docs.BasePart:IntersectAsync: Creates a new IntersectOperation from the overlapping geometry of the part and the other parts in the given array.
docs.BasePart.Touched: Fires when a part touches another part as a result of physical movement.
docs.BasePart.TouchEnded: Fires when a part stops touching another part as a result of physical movement.
docs.Terrain: Terrain lets you to create dynamically morphable environments.
docs.Terrain.WaterReflectance: Controls how opaque Terrain water reflections are.
docs.Terrain.WaterWaveSize: Sets the maximum height of Terrain water waves in studs.
docs.Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed: Sets how many times Terrain water waves will move up and down per minute.
docs.Terrain:FillBlock: Fills a block of smooth terrain with a given location, rotation, size, and material.
docs.Terrain:FillBall: Fills a ball of smooth terrain in a given space.
docs.Terrain:FillCylinder: Fills a cylinder of smooth terrain in a given space.
docs.Terrain:FillWedge: Fills a wedge-shaped volume of terrain with the given Enum.Material.
docs.Terrain:CountCells: Returns the number of non-empty cells in the terrain.
docs.Terrain:WorldToCell: Returns the grid cell location that contains the position point.
docs.Terrain:WorldToCellPreferSolid: Returns the grid cell location that contains the point position, preferring non-empty grid cells when position is on a grid edge.
docs.Terrain:WorldToCellPreferEmpty: Returns the grid cell location that contains the position point, preferring empty grid cells when position is on a grid edge.
docs.Terrain:CellCenterToWorld: Returns the world position of the center of the terrain cell.
docs.Terrain:CellCornerToWorld: Returns the position of the lower-left-forward corner of the grid cell.
docs.Terrain:GetMaterialColor: Returns current terrain material color for specified terrain material.
docs.Terrain:SetMaterialColor: Sets current terrain material color for specified terrain material.
docs.Part: A common type of BasePart that comes in different primitive shapes.
docs.Part.Shape: Sets the overall shape of the object.

docs.WedgePart: A type of BasePart that has a wedge shape.
docs.TriangleMeshPart: Abstract intermediate class that manages physical geometry properties for PartOperations and MeshParts.
docs.TriangleMeshPart.CollisionFidelity: Determines the level of detail the part's physics will adhere to its mesh.
docs.TriangleMeshPart.MeshSize: The original size of the part's source mesh geometry, before any scaling applied through BasePart.Size.
docs.MeshPart: A form of BasePart that includes a physically simulated custom mesh.
docs.MeshPart.MeshId: The asset URIs of the mesh that is displayed on the MeshPart. Reads and writes to MeshContent.
docs.MeshPart.TextureID: The texture applied to the MeshPart. Reads and writes to TextureContent.
docs.MeshPart.DoubleSided: Determines whether to render both faces of polygons in the mesh.
docs.MeshPart.RenderFidelity: The level of detail used to render the MeshPart.

docs.PartOperation.UsePartColor: Sets whether the PartOperation can be recolored using inherited color properties.
docs.PartOperation.RenderFidelity: The level of detail used to render the solid modeled part.
docs.PartOperation.SmoothingAngle: An angle in degrees which affects the smooth shading of a solid modeled part.
docs.PartOperation.TriangleCount: The number of polygons in this solid model.
docs.UnionOperation: Result of parts that have been joined together into a single solid model.
docs.NegateOperation: Result of a part that has been negated for use in solid modeling.
docs.IntersectOperation: Result of parts that have been intersected into a single solid model.

docs.Decal: Applies an image texture to a face of a parent BasePart.
docs.Decal.Texture: The content ID of the image to be applied by the Decal.
docs.Decal.Face: Sets which face of the parent BasePart the object appears on.
docs.Decal.Transparency: Determines the transparency of the Decal.
docs.Decal.Color3: The Color3 tint of the Decal.
docs.Texture: Applies a repeating image texture to the face of a parent BasePart.
docs.Texture.StudsPerTileU: Sets the horizontal size, in studs, of the tiled image applied by the Texture.
docs.Texture.StudsPerTileV: Sets the vertical size, in studs, of the tiled image applied by the Texture.
docs.Texture.OffsetStudsU: Determines the offset in studs of the rendered texture's horizontal coordinate.
docs.Texture.OffsetStudsV: Determines the offset in studs of the rendered texture's vertical coordinate.
docs.LuaSourceContainer: The base class for all objects which contain Luau code.
docs.LuaSourceContainer.Enabled: Determines whether a BaseScript runs or not.
docs.Script: An object that contains and runs Luau code on the server.
docs.LocalScript: An object that contains and runs Luau code on the client (player's device) instead of the server.
docs.ModuleScript: A script type that runs once when LuaGlobals.require() is called with it. Returns exactly one value, usually a table of functions, to used by other scripts. Useful for compartmentalizing code.
docs.Lighting: The Lighting service controls global lighting in an experience. It includes a range of adjustable properties that you can use to change how lighting appears and interacts with other objects.
docs.Lighting.Ambient: The lighting hue applied to areas that are occluded from the sky, such as indoor areas.
docs.Lighting.OutdoorAmbient: The lighting hue applied to outdoor areas.
docs.Lighting.Brightness: The intensity of illumination in the place.
docs.Lighting.ClockTime: A numerical representation (in hours) of the current time of day used by Lighting.
docs.Lighting.TimeOfDay: A 24-hour string representation of the current time of day used by Lighting.
docs.Lighting.GeographicLatitude: The geographic latitude, in degrees, of the scene, influencing the result of Lighting time on the position of the sun and moon.
docs.Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale: Ambient light that is derived from the environment.
docs.Lighting.GlobalShadows: Toggles voxel-based dynamic lighting for the place.
docs.Lighting.ShadowSoftness: Controls how blurry the shadows are.
docs.Lighting.ColorShift_Top: The hue represented in light reflected from surfaces facing the sun or moon.
docs.Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom: The hue represented in light reflected in the opposite surfaces to those facing the sun or moon.
docs.Lighting.FogColor: A Color3 value giving the hue of Lighting fog.
docs.Lighting.FogStart: The depth from the Workspace.CurrentCamera, in studs, at which fog begins to show.
docs.Lighting.FogEnd: The depth from the Workspace.CurrentCamera, in studs, at which fog will be completely opaque.
docs.Lighting.LightingStyle: The artistic intent behind lighting in the experience.
docs.Lighting.PrioritizeLightingQuality: Indicates whether you prefer lighting/shading quality or view distance to scale down first.
docs.Lighting:GetSunDirection: Returns a Vector3 representing the direction of the sun.
docs.Lighting:GetMoonDirection: Returns a Vector3 representing the direction of the moon.
docs.Lighting:GetMinutesAfterMidnight: Returns the number of minutes that have passed after midnight for the purposes of lighting.
docs.Lighting:SetMinutesAfterMidnight: Sets TimeOfDay and ClockTime to the given number of minutes after midnight.
docs.Lighting.LightingChanged: This event fires when a Lighting property is changed or a Sky is added or removed from Lighting.
docs.PostEffect: Abstract base class for post-processing effects.
docs.PostEffect.Enabled: Toggles whether or not the PostEffect is enabled.
docs.BloomEffect: Simulates the camera viewing a very bright light.
docs.BloomEffect.Size: Determines the radius of the bloom in pixels.
docs.BloomEffect.Threshold: Determines how bright a color must be before it blooms.
docs.ColorCorrectionEffect: Adjusts color-related properties of the rendered world like saturation, tint, brightness, and contrast.
docs.ColorCorrectionEffect.Brightness: Determines by how much the brightness of pixel colors will be shifted.
docs.ColorCorrectionEffect.Contrast: Determines the change in separation between the dark and light colors.
docs.ColorCorrectionEffect.Saturation: Determines the change in intensity of colors.
docs.ColorCorrectionEffect.TintColor: Determines by how much the RGB channels of pixels are scaled.
docs.DepthOfFieldEffect: Simulates a camera lens by blurring parts of a scene not in focus.
docs.DepthOfFieldEffect.FarIntensity: Intensity of the far field blur.
docs.DepthOfFieldEffect.FocusDistance: Distance away from the camera where objects are in focus.
docs.DepthOfFieldEffect.InFocusRadius: Controls the distance away from the FocusDistance where no blur is applied.
docs.DepthOfFieldEffect.NearIntensity: Intensity of the near field blur.
docs.SunRaysEffect: Renders dynamic rays from the sun.
docs.SunRaysEffect.Intensity: Determines the opacity of the sun rays.
docs.SunRaysEffect.Spread: Determines how wide the sun rays will spread out.
docs.BlurEffect: Applies a blur to the entire game world.
docs.ColorGradingEffect: Modifies how color values calculated by the renderer should be converted to the screen's color range.
docs.ColorGradingEffect.TonemapperPreset: Specifies which tone mapper preset to use.
docs.Atmosphere: The Atmosphere object pushes Roblox closer toward realistic environments where sunlight scatters in different ways depending on density and other air particle properties.
docs.Atmosphere.Density: Defines the amount of particles in the Atmosphere and essentially controls how much in-game objects/terrain will be obscured by them.
docs.Atmosphere.Offset: Controls how light transmits between the camera and the sky background.
docs.Atmosphere.Color: Changes the Atmosphere hue for subtle environmental moods.
docs.Atmosphere.Decay: When used with increased Atmosphere.Haze and Atmosphere.Glare, defines the hue of the Atmosphere away from the sun, gradually falling off from Atmosphere.Color towards this value.
docs.Atmosphere.Glare: When used with increased Atmosphere.Haze, specifies the glow/glare of the Atmosphere around the sun. More glare results in an increased effect of sunlight cast onto the sky and world.
docs.Atmosphere.Haze: Defines the haziness of the Atmosphere with a visible effect both above the horizon and into the distance.
docs.Sky: Changes the default appearance of the experience's sky.
docs.Sky.CelestialBodiesShown: Sets whether the sun, moon, and stars will render in the skybox.
docs.Sky.StarCount: How many stars are shown in the skybox.
docs.Sky.SunAngularSize: The perceived angular size of the sun while using this skybox, in degrees.
docs.Sky.MoonAngularSize: The perceived angular size of the moon while using this skybox, in degrees. Defaults to 11 and is clamped to the range [0, 60].
docs.Highlight: A visual effect which you can use to call attention to a specific object within an experience.
docs.Highlight.Adornee: The Instance that the Highlight is applied to.
docs.Highlight.DepthMode: Controls how the Highlight effect displays with respect to other objects in the world.
docs.Highlight.Enabled: Sets whether or not the highlight is enabled.
docs.Highlight.FillColor: Sets the Color3 value of the highlight's interior.
docs.Highlight.FillTransparency: Sets the transparency of the highlight's interior.
docs.Highlight.OutlineColor: Sets the Color3 value of the highlight's outline.
docs.Highlight.OutlineTransparency: Sets the transparency of the highlight's outline.
docs.Attachment: Defines a point and orientation relative to an ancestor PVInstance, Bone, or another Attachment.
docs.Attachment.Position: Positional offset of the attachment, relative to the position and orientation of its parent.
docs.Attachment.Orientation: Orientation of the attachment relative to the orientation of its parent.
docs.Attachment.Visible: Toggles the in-experience visibility of the attachment.
docs.Attachment.Axis: Direction of the X axis of the attachment, represented as a unit Vector3.
docs.Attachment.SecondaryAxis: Direction of the Y axis of the attachment, represented as a unit Vector3.
docs.Attachment.WorldCFrame: The exact CFrame of the attachment in world space coordinates.
docs.Attachment.WorldPosition: Position of the attachment relative to the world rather than its own parent.
docs.Attachment.WorldOrientation: Orientation of the attachment relative to the world rather than its own parent.
docs.Attachment.WorldAxis: Direction of the X axis of the attachment relative to the world, represented as a unit Vector3 with a length of 1.
docs.Attachment.WorldSecondaryAxis: Direction of the Y axis of the attachment relative to the world, represented as a unit Vector3 with a length of 1.
docs.JointInstance.Part0: The first BasePart that the joint connects.
docs.JointInstance.Part1: The second BasePart that the joint connects.
docs.JointInstance.C0: Determines how the offset point is attached to JointInstance.Part0.
docs.JointInstance.C1: Subtracted from the C0 property to create an offset point for Part1.
docs.JointInstance.Enabled: Sets whether the joint is active or not.
docs.JointInstance.Active: Determines if the joint is currently active in the world.
docs.Weld: Holds two BaseParts together in a fixed relative position, regardless of whether they're touching.
docs.Snap: Holds two parts together and functions identically to Weld.
docs.Motor: Makes a movable JointInstance between two parts.
docs.Motor.CurrentAngle: Displays the current rotation of the motor in radians.
docs.Motor.DesiredAngle: The desired angle to turn the motor to in radians.
docs.Motor.MaxVelocity: The maximum velocity the motor can use to reach Motor.DesiredAngle measured in radians per physics frame (1/60th of a second).
docs.Motor6D: Creates an animatable joint between two BaseParts. Superseded by AnimationConstraint for avatar/character rigs. Motor6D is no longer used by default for player characters when AvatarJointUpgrade is enabled.
docs.Motor6D.Transform: Describes the current animation offset of the Motor6D joint.
docs.Motor6D.ChildName: Read-only name of the joint's child part, mirroring the Name of Part1.
docs.WeldConstraint: Connects two BaseParts together such that their relative position and orientation remain the same.
docs.WeldConstraint.Part0: The first part connected by the constraint.
docs.WeldConstraint.Part1: The second part connected by the constraint.
docs.WeldConstraint.Enabled: Toggles the constraint on and off.
docs.WeldConstraint.Active: Indicates if the WeldConstraint is currently active in the world.
docs.Light: Light is a root class for dynamic lighting related objects.
docs.Light.Brightness: Sets how bright the emitted light is, defaults to 1.
docs.Light.Color: The color of the emitted light.
docs.Light.Enabled: If set to true, light will be emitted from the source object.
docs.Light.Shadows: If set to true, will project shadows if light is blocked by an obstacle.
docs.PointLight: A light source that emits illumination from a single point.
docs.PointLight.Range: The size of the area that the PointLight will illuminate.
docs.ParticleEmitter: A special object that emits customizable 2D particles into the world.
docs.ParticleEmitter.Acceleration: Determines the global-axis acceleration of all active particles, measured in studs per second squared.
docs.ParticleEmitter.Brightness: Scales the light emitted from the emitter when ParticleEmitter.LightInfluence is 0.
docs.ParticleEmitter.Color: Determines the color of all active particles over their individual lifetimes.
docs.ParticleEmitter.Drag: Determines the rate at which particles will lose half their speed through exponential decay.
docs.ParticleEmitter.EmissionDirection: Determines the face of the object that particles emit from.
docs.ParticleEmitter.Enabled: Determines if particles emit from the emitter.
docs.ParticleEmitter.FlipbookBlendFrames: Determines whether the flipbook frames are blended between.
docs.ParticleEmitter.FlipbookFramerate: Determines how fast the flipbook texture animates in frames per second.
docs.ParticleEmitter.FlipbookLayout: Determines the layout of the flipbook texture. Must be None, Grid2x2, Grid4x4, Grid8x8 or Custom.
docs.ParticleEmitter.FlipbookMode: Determines the type of the flipbook animation. Must be Loop, OneShot, PingPong, or Random.
docs.ParticleEmitter.FlipbookSizeX: Defines the number of horizontal frames in a custom flipbook layout.
docs.ParticleEmitter.FlipbookSizeY: Defines the number of vertical frames in a custom flipbook layout.
docs.ParticleEmitter.FlipbookStartRandom: Determines whether the animation starts at a random frame chosen per particle instead of always starting at frame zero.
docs.ParticleEmitter.Lifetime: Defines a random range of ages for newly emitted particles.
docs.ParticleEmitter.LightEmission: Determines how much particles' colors are blended with the colors behind them.
docs.ParticleEmitter.LightInfluence: Determines how much particles are influenced by the environmental light.
docs.ParticleEmitter.LockedToPart: Determines whether the particles rigidly move with the part they're being emitted from.
docs.ParticleEmitter.Rate: Determines the number of particles emitted per second.
docs.ParticleEmitter.RotSpeed: Determines the range of angular speeds of emitted particles, measured in degrees per second.
docs.ParticleEmitter.Rotation: Determines the range of rotations in degrees for newly emitted particles.
docs.ParticleEmitter.Shape: Sets the shape of the emitter to either a box, sphere, cylinder, or disc.
docs.ParticleEmitter.ShapeInOut: Sets whether particles emit outward only, inward only, or in both directions.
docs.ParticleEmitter.ShapePartial: Influences particle emission from cylinder, disc, sphere, and box shapes.
docs.ParticleEmitter.ShapeStyle: Sets particle emission to either volumetric or surface-only emission.
docs.ParticleEmitter.Size: Determines the world size over individual particles' lifetimes.
docs.ParticleEmitter.Speed: Determines a random range of velocities (minimum to maximum) at which new particles will emit, measured in studs per second.
docs.ParticleEmitter.SpreadAngle: Determines the angles at which particles may be randomly emit, measured in degrees.
docs.ParticleEmitter.Squash: Allows for non-uniform scaling of particles, curve-controlled over their lifetime.
docs.ParticleEmitter.Texture: Determines the image rendered on particles.
docs.ParticleEmitter.TimeScale: Value between 0 and 1 that controls the speed of the particle effect.
docs.ParticleEmitter.Transparency: Determines the transparency of particles over their individual lifetimes.
docs.ParticleEmitter.VelocityInheritance: Determines how much of the parent's velocity is inherited by particles when emitted.
docs.ParticleEmitter.WindAffectsDrag: Whether emitted particles follow the Workspace.GlobalWind vector.
docs.ParticleEmitter.ZOffset: Determines the forward-backward render position of particles; used to control what particles render on top/bottom.
docs.ParticleEmitter:Emit: Emits a given number of particles.
docs.ParticleEmitter:Clear: Clears all particles that have been emitted.
docs.SpotLight: A light source that emits light directionally in the shape of a cone with a spherical base.
docs.SpotLight.Range: The size of the area that the SpotLight will illuminate.
docs.SpotLight.Angle: The angle of which the light is shone from the SpotLight.
docs.SpotLight.Face: Sets the side of the parent that the SpotLight comes from.
docs.SurfaceLight: A light source that emits illumination of a specified color and brightness from a face for a specified range.
docs.SurfaceLight.Range: The distance from the SurfaceLight's face that will illuminate.
docs.SurfaceLight.Angle: The angle of which the light is shone from the SurfaceLight.
docs.SurfaceLight.Face: Sets the side of the parent that the SurfaceLight comes from.
docs.Camera: A class which defines a view of the 3D world.
docs.Camera.CFrame: The CFrame of the Camera, defining its position and orientation in the 3D world.
docs.Camera.Focus: Sets the area in 3D space that is prioritized by Roblox's graphical systems.
docs.Camera.FieldOfView: Sets the angle of the camera's vertical field of view.
docs.Camera.CameraType: Specifies the Enum.CameraType to be read by the camera scripts.
docs.Camera.CameraSubject: The Humanoid or BasePart that is the Camera subject.
docs.Camera.ViewportSize: The dimensions of the device safe area on a Roblox client.
docs.Camera.NearPlaneZ: Describes the negative Z offset, in studs, of the camera's near clipping plane.
docs.Camera:WorldToViewportPoint: Returns the screen location and depth of a Vector3 worldPoint and whether this point is within the bounds of the screen. Does not account for the GUI inset.
docs.Camera:WorldToScreenPoint: Returns the screen location and depth of a Vector3 worldPoint and whether this point is within the bounds of the screen. Accounts for the GUI inset.
docs.UserSettings: Returns the UserSettings object, which is used to read information from the current user's game menu settings.
docs.UserSettings:GetService: Returns the service with the requested class name, creating it if it does not exist.
docs.UserGameSettings: UserGameSettings is a singleton class found inside of the UserSettings singleton. It holds various persistent settings relating to how the user wants to control their camera, and their character.
docs.UserGameSettings.SavedQualityLevel: The graphics quality level set by the client.
docs.Players: A service that contains presently connected Player objects.
docs.Players.LocalPlayer: The Player that the LocalScript is running for.
docs.Players.RespawnTime: Controls the amount of time taken for a players character to respawn.
docs.Players.CharacterAutoLoads: Indicates whether characters will respawn automatically.
docs.Players:GetPlayers: Returns a table of all presently connected Player objects.
docs.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter: Returns the Player whose Player.Character matches the given instance, or nil if one cannot be found.
docs.Players.PlayerAdded: Fires when a player enters the experience.
docs.Players.PlayerRemoving: Fires when a player is about to leave the experience.
docs.Player: An object that represents a presently connected client to the experience.
docs.Player.UserId: A unique identifying integer assigned to all user accounts.
docs.Player.DisplayName: The display name of the authenticated user associated with the Player.
docs.Player.Character: A Model controlled by the player that contains a Humanoid, body parts, scripts, and other objects.
docs.Player.RespawnLocation: If set, the player will respawn at the given SpawnLocation.
docs.Player.AutoJumpEnabled: Determines whether the character of a player using a mobile device will automatically jump upon hitting an obstacle.
docs.Player:LoadCharacter: Creates a new character for the player, removing the old one. Also clears the player's Backpack and PlayerGui.
docs.Player.CharacterAdded: Fires when a player's character spawns or respawns.
docs.Player.CharacterRemoving: Fires right before a player's character is removed.
docs.Humanoid: A special object that gives models the functionality of a character.
docs.Humanoid.Health: Describes the current health of the Humanoid on the range [0, Humanoid.MaxHealth].
docs.Humanoid.MaxHealth: The maximum value of a humanoid's Health.
docs.Humanoid.WalkSpeed: Describes the humanoid's maximum movement speed in studs per second.
docs.Humanoid.JumpPower: Determines how much upwards force is applied to the Humanoid when jumping.
docs.Humanoid.JumpHeight: Provides control over the height that the Humanoid jumps to.
docs.Humanoid.UseJumpPower: Determines whether the JumpHeight (false) or Humanoid.JumpPower (true) property is used.
docs.Humanoid.AutoJumpEnabled: Sets whether the character will automatically jump when they hit an obstacle as a player on a mobile device.
docs.Humanoid.MaxSlopeAngle: The maximum slope angle that a humanoid can walk on without slipping.
docs.Humanoid.HipHeight: Determines the distance off the ground the Humanoid.RootPart should be.
docs.Humanoid.Jump: If true, the Humanoid jumps with an upwards force.
docs.Humanoid.MoveDirection: Describes the direction that the Humanoid is walking in.
docs.Humanoid.FloorMaterial: Describes the Enum.Material that the Humanoid is currently standing on. If the Humanoid isn't standing on anything, the value of this property will be Air.
docs.Humanoid:TakeDamage: Lowers the Humanoid.Health of the Humanoid by the given amount if it is not protected by a ForceField.
docs.Humanoid:LoadAnimation: Loads an Animation onto a Humanoid, returning an AnimationTrack that can be used for playback.
docs.Humanoid.HealthChanged: Fires when the Humanoid.Health changes (or when the Humanoid.MaxHealth is set).
docs.Humanoid.Jumping: Fires when the Humanoid enters and leaves the Jumping Enum.HumanoidStateType.
docs.Humanoid.Running: Fires when the speed at which a Humanoid is running changes.
docs.Humanoid.FreeFalling: Fires when the Humanoid enters or leaves the Freefall Enum.HumanoidStateType.
docs.Humanoid.Touched: Fires when one of the humanoid's limbs come in contact with another BasePart.
docs.AnimationClip: Represents all types of animation data that the Roblox animation system can consume.
docs.AnimationClip.Loop: Determines whether the animation stored in this AnimationClip is intended to loop.
docs.AnimationClip.Priority: Determines which clip takes priority when multiple animations are playing simultaneously.
docs.KeyframeSequence: This object stores all of the Keyframes and other data for the animation.
docs.KeyframeSequence:AddKeyframe: Adds a Keyframe to the KeyframeSequence by parenting it to the KeyframeSequence.
docs.KeyframeSequence:RemoveKeyframe: This method removes a Keyframe from the KeyframeSequence by setting its parent to nil.
docs.KeyframeSequence:GetKeyframes: Returns an array that contains all Keyframes contained in a KeyframeSequence.
docs.Keyframe: A Keyframe holds the Poses applied to joints in a Model at a given point of time in an animation. Keyframes are interpolated between during animation playback.
docs.Keyframe.Time: The Keyframe time position (in seconds) in an animation. This determines the time at which the Poses inside the keyframe will be shown.
docs.Keyframe:AddPose: Adds a Pose to the Keyframe by parenting it to the keyframe.
docs.Keyframe:RemovePose: Removes a Pose from the Keyframe by setting its Instance.Parent to nil.
docs.Keyframe:GetPoses: Returns an array containing all Poses that have been added to a Keyframe.
docs.Keyframe:AddMarker: Adds a KeyframeMarker to the Keyframe by parenting it to the keyframe.
docs.Keyframe:RemoveMarker: Removes a KeyframeMarker from the Keyframe by settings its Instance.Parent to nil.
docs.Keyframe:GetMarkers: Returns an array containing all KeyframeMarkers that have been added to the Keyframe.
docs.KeyframeMarker: An instance meant to represent an event that will eventually be fired when a Keyframe is hit.
docs.KeyframeMarker.Value: A value that is specified for a KeyframeMarker.
docs.PoseBase: Base class of all 'Pose Instance' objects.
docs.PoseBase.EasingStyle: The easing style to use to reach the next Pose's value.
docs.PoseBase.EasingDirection: The easing direction to use to reach the next Pose's value.
docs.Pose: Holds the CFrame applied to the Motor6D connected to its associated BasePart. The part which is controlled depends on the name of the Pose.
docs.Pose.CFrame: This CFrame applies to the Motor6D corresponding with the Pose when the Motor6D.Transform is changed.
docs.Pose:AddSubPose: Adds a sub Pose to the Pose by parenting it.
docs.Pose:RemoveSubPose: Removes a sub Pose from the Pose by parenting it to nil.
docs.Pose:GetSubPoses: Returns an array containing all sub Poses that have been added to a Pose.
docs.Animation: References an animation asset which can be loaded by an AnimationController.
docs.Animation.AnimationId: Asset ID of the animation an Animation object is referencing.
docs.KeyframeSequenceProvider: Provides functions to load and preview KeyframeSequence.
docs.KeyframeSequenceProvider:RegisterKeyfram: Generates a temporary asset ID from a KeyframeSequence that can be used for localized testing of an animation. Generates a hash.
docs.KeyframeSequenceProvider:RegisterActiveK: Generates a temporary asset ID from a KeyframeSequence that can be used for localized testing of an animation. Generates an active:// URL.
docs.Animator: Responsible for the playback and replication of Animations.
docs.Animator:LoadAnimation: Loads an Animation onto an Animator, returning an AnimationTrack.
docs.Animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks: Returns the list of currently active AnimationTracks.
docs.Animator:StepAnimations: Increments the AnimationTrack.TimePosition of all playing AnimationTracks that are loaded onto the Animator, applying the offsets to the model associated with the Animator. For use in the command bar or by plugins only.
docs.Animator.AnimationPlayed: Fires when the Animator starts playing an AnimationTrack.
docs.AnimationTrack: Controls the playback of an animation on an Animator.
docs.AnimationTrack.Animation: The Animation object that was used to create this AnimationTrack.
docs.AnimationTrack.IsPlaying: A read-only property that returns true when the AnimationTrack is playing.
docs.AnimationTrack.Length: A read-only property that returns the length (in seconds) of an AnimationTrack. This will return 0 until the animation has fully loaded and thus may not be immediately available.
docs.AnimationTrack.Looped: Sets whether the animation will repeat after finishing. If it is changed while playing the result will take effect after the animation finishes.
docs.AnimationTrack.Priority: Sets the priority of an AnimationTrack. Depending on what this is set to, playing multiple animations at once will look to this property to figure out which Keyframe Poses should be played over one another.
docs.AnimationTrack.Speed: Read-only property that gives the current playback speed of the AnimationTrack.
docs.AnimationTrack.TimePosition: Returns the position in time in seconds that an AnimationTrack is through playing its source animation. Can be set to make the track jump to a specific moment in the animation.
docs.AnimationTrack.WeightCurrent: Read-only property that gives the current weight of the AnimationTrack.
docs.AnimationTrack.WeightTarget: Read-only property that gives the current weight of the AnimationTrack.
docs.AnimationTrack:Play: Plays the AnimationTrack. Once called an AnimationTrack will play with the specified fadeTime, weight and speed.
docs.AnimationTrack:AdjustSpeed: Changes the AnimationTrack.Speed of an animation. A positive value for speed plays the animation forward, a negative one plays it backwards, and 0 pauses it.
docs.AnimationTrack:AdjustWeight: Changes the weight of an animation, with the optional fadeTime parameter determining how long it takes for AnimationTrack.WeightCurrent to reach AnimationTrack.WeightTarget.
docs.AnimationTrack:GetTimeOfKeyframe: Returns the time position of the first Keyframe of the given name in an AnimationTrack.
docs.AnimationTrack.DidLoop: Fires when an AnimationTrack loops on the next update following the end of the previous animation loop.
docs.AnimationTrack.Ended: Fires when the AnimationTrack is completely done moving anything in the world.
docs.AnimationTrack.KeyframeReached: Fires every time playback of an AnimationTrack reaches a Keyframe that does not have the default name of Keyframe.
docs.AnimationTrack.Stopped: Fires when the AnimationTrack finishes playing. The AnimationTrack might still animate the subject while the animation "fades out". To catch when the AnimationTrack is completely done moving anything in the world, use the AnimationTrack.Ended event.
docs.ValueBase: Base class of all "value instance" objects.
docs.BoolValue: A container object for a single boolean value.
docs.BoolValue.Value: Used to hold a boolean value.
docs.NumberValue: A container object for a single double-precision floating point number.
docs.NumberValue.Value: Used to hold a double value.
docs.IntValue: A container object for a single integer.
docs.StringValue: A container object for a single string.
docs.ObjectValue: A container object for a reference to another instance.
docs.ObjectValue.Value: Holds a reference to an instance.
docs.BrickColor: A data type that provides a predefined list of named colors.
docs.BrickColor.new: Constructs a BrickColor from its numerical index.
docs.BrickColor.palette: Constructs a BrickColor from its palette index.
docs.BrickColor.Number: The unique number that identifies the BrickColor.
docs.BrickColor.r: The red component of the BrickColor (between 0 and 1).
docs.BrickColor.g: The green component of the BrickColor (between 0 and 1).
docs.BrickColor.b: The blue component of the BrickColor (between 0 and 1).
docs.BrickColor.Name: The name associated with the BrickColor.
docs.BrickColor.Color: The Color3 associated with the BrickColor.
docs.CFrame: A data type that represents both a 3D position and orientation.
docs.CFrame.new: Returns a CFrame with no rotation with the position of the provided Vector3.
docs.CFrame.lookAt: Returns a CFrame with the position of the first Vector3 and an orientation pointed toward the second.
docs.CFrame.lookAlong: Returns a CFrame with the position of the first Vector3 and an orientation directed along the second.
docs.CFrame.fromRotationBetweenVectors: Returns a CFrame representing the orientation needed to rotate from the first Vector3 to the second, with the position set to zero.
docs.CFrame.fromEulerAngles: Returns a rotated CFrame from angles rx, ry, and rz in radians. Rotations are applied in the optional Enum.RotationOrder with a default of XYZ.
docs.CFrame.fromEulerAnglesXYZ: Returns a rotated CFrame from angles rx, ry, and rz in radians using Enum.RotationOrder.XYZ.
docs.CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ: Returns a rotated CFrame from angles rx, ry, and rz in radians using Enum.RotationOrder.YXZ.
docs.CFrame.fromAxisAngle: Returns a rotated CFrame from a unit Vector3 and a rotation in radians.
docs.CFrame.fromMatrix: Returns a CFrame from a translation and the columns of a rotation matrix.
docs.CFrame.identity: An identity CFrame with no translation or rotation.
docs.CFrame.Rotation: A copy of the CFrame with no translation.
docs.CFrame.X: The X coordinate of the position.
docs.CFrame.Y: The Y coordinate of the position.
docs.CFrame.Z: The Z coordinate of the position.
docs.CFrame.LookVector: The forward-direction component of the CFrame object's orientation, equivalent to the negated form of ZVector.
docs.CFrame.RightVector: The right-direction component of the CFrame object's orientation.
docs.CFrame.UpVector: The up-direction component of the CFrame object's orientation.
docs.CFrame.ZVector: The Z component of the CFrame object's orientation. Equivalent to the third column of the rotation matrix.
docs.CFrame:Inverse: Returns the inverse of the CFrame.
docs.CFrame:Lerp: Returns a CFrame interpolated between itself and goal by the fraction alpha.
docs.CFrame:Orthonormalize: Returns an orthonormalized copy of the CFrame.
docs.CFrame:ToWorldSpace: Receives one or more CFrame objects and returns them transformed from object to world space.
docs.CFrame:ToObjectSpace: Receives one or more CFrame objects and returns them transformed from world to object space.
docs.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace: Receives one or more Vector3 objects and returns them transformed from object to world space.

docs.Enum.ParticleEmitterShape: Specifies the geometric shape from which a particle emitter emits particles.
docs.Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut: Controls the direction particles travel when emitted from a shaped ParticleEmitter.
docs.Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle: Controls whether a ParticleEmitter emits particles from the surface or the volume of its shape.
docs.Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout: Determines the layout of the flipbook texture.
docs.Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode: Determines the type of the flipbook animation.
docs.Enum.HighlightDepthMode: Controls how the Highlight effect displays with respect to other objects in the world.
docs.Enum.SavedQualitySetting: Represents the user's saved graphics quality preference, stored in UserGameSettings.SavedQualityLevel.
docs.Enum.RaycastFilterType: Used in a RaycastParams object to determine how its FilterDescendantsInstances list will be used.
docs.Enum.TonemapperPreset: Controls which tone-mapping algorithm ColorGradingEffect applies to the rendered scene.
docs.Enum.AnimationPriority: The AnimationPriority Enum determines how concurrently-playing AnimationTracks contribute to the final animation.
docs.Enum.PoseEasingStyle: Specifies the interpolation curve used when blending between keyframe Poses in a KeyframeSequence.
docs.Enum.PoseEasingDirection: Used exclusively by Pose.EasingDirection to specify direction of the EasingStyle curve.
docs.Enum.CameraType: Describes the camera behavior mode if using the default PlayerScripts.
docs.Enum.EasingStyle: Enum used with TweenInfo.new to control the motion of a Tween.
docs.Enum.EasingDirection: Enum used with TweenInfo.new() to control the direction Tweens play in.
docs.Enum.PlaybackState: Describes the current state of a Tween in its Tween.PlaybackState property.
docs.Enum.Font: Determines the font used to render text in GUI objects such as TextLabel, TextButton, and TextBox. This is a legacy property. For new work, use Font, FontFace, and FontFace instead.
docs.Enum.FontStyle: Describes whether a Font style is normal or italic.
docs.Enum.FillDirection: Used by UIGridStyleLayout.FillDirection to control which direction elements are placed.
docs.Enum.HorizontalAlignment: Used by UIGridStyleLayout.HorizontalAlignment to align the layout horizontally within its parent.
docs.Enum.VerticalAlignment: Used by UIGridStyleLayout.VerticalAlignment to align the layout vertically within its parent.
docs.Enum.SortOrder: Used by UIGridStyleLayout.SortOrder to order the elements in the layout.
docs.Enum.ZIndexBehavior: Used by LayerCollector.ZIndexBehavior to control how the GuiObject.ZIndex property behaves for descendants.
docs.Enum.ApplyStrokeMode: Used by UIStroke.ApplyStrokeMode to determine where to apply the stroke.
docs.Enum.ScaleType: Determines how an image (of a ImageLabel or ImageButton) is scaled.
docs.Enum.AspectType: Used by UIAspectRatioConstraint.AspectType to control sizing behavior.
docs.Enum.DominantAxis: Used by UIAspectRatioConstraint.DominantAxis for resizing the object to maintain the aspect ratio.
docs.Enum.TextTruncate: Controls the truncation of text when using the TextTruncate property.
docs.Enum.AutomaticSize: UI objects with AutomaticSize enabled will increase in size up to maximum size allowed by the parent (if there is one) and no smaller than the Size property bounds.
docs.Enum.ScrollingDirection: This enum is used by ScrollingFrame.ScrollingDirection to specify the direction(s) in which scrolling is allowed.
docs.Enum.ElasticBehavior: This enum is used by ScrollingFrame.ElasticBehavior to control when elastic scrolling is active on touch‑enabled devices.
docs.Enum.ScrollBarInset: This enum is used with ScrollingFrame.HorizontalScrollBarInset and ScrollingFrame.VerticalScrollBarInset to indicate whether the canvas should be inset by ScrollBarThickness for the respective scroll bar.
docs.Enum.VerticalScrollBarPosition: This enum is used for ScrollingFrame.VerticalScrollBarPosition to indicate vertical scroll bar positioning.
docs.Enum.StartCorner: Used by UIGridLayout.StartCorner to decide where the first element is placed.
docs.Enum.LightingStyle: Enum used by Lighting.LightingStyle to indicate the artistic intent behind lighting in the experience.
docs.Enum.CollisionFidelity: Determines behavior of the collision hitbox for MeshPart and PartOperation instances.
docs.Enum.RenderFidelity: Determines the level of detail that solid modeled and mesh parts will be shown in.
docs.Enum.CoreGuiType: Represents all available CoreGui "types" such as the Backpack and text chat window.
